newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayernwerk allows 8.4 bln dmk for closing plants.
newsitem.headline: Bayernwerk allows 8.4 bln dmk for closing plants.

text.p: Utility Bayernwerk AG said on Wednesday that it had set aside reserves of 8.4 billion marks for the disposal of nuclear waste and for the future mothballing of nuclear plants.
Bayernwerk's chief financial officer Manfred Klis said that it considered this method of alloting hidden reserves was the best way to provide for such eventualities.
In 1995 the Viag subsidiary allowed for 8.3 billion marks in reserves for the same purpose.
Earlier this year Bayernwerk spoke out against the possible introduction of legislation aimed at taxing the reserves set aside for shutting down their nuclear plants.
